name: @useyolo/proxy-url
description: Official Yolo proxy provider plugin: a fixed http or https proxy, with its credentials, read from an environment variable, for the media node's egress rules

summary.en: An http or https proxy for the node's egress rules.
summary.zh: 给节点出站规则用的 http 或 https 代理。

privacy.en: Sends the requests your egress rules name through the proxy you set.
privacy.zh: 按你的出站规则，把指定的请求经你设置的代理发出。
